links.why: The national map does not draw 버들골 풍산마당. OpenStreetMap does.
The national map does not draw 데이터사이언스대학원. OpenStreetMap does.
The national map draws 종합운동장본부석 only as a wall-less structure, which the seed leaves out.
The polygon that holds the position of 화학관연결동 has no label and is not this building.
The national map labels a second polygon, B0010000000RF2EB9 at 국제대학원, as 104-1동. It is not this building's.
